body:
Verify you are human

Please complete the CAPTCHA below to continue to the site.
note: A reCAPTCHA full-page GATE: sparse (content-light) page whose purpose is the CAPTCHA. KEY1 = the reCAPTCHA api.js + g-recaptcha widget; KEY2 = content-light AND gate copy ('verify you are human' / 'complete the captcha'). Distinct from a login/contact form that merely embeds reCAPTCHA (content-rich, no gate copy).
